limits: Native transfer ACK proves verified application X client read data; it does not prove widget insertion, operation effect, or causal attribution to one exact paste. Operation caller must read actual application state.
Native timestamps are milliseconds; same-timestamp ownership changes and same-owner internal mutation are not a strict compare-and-swap. No global server grab.
Prior text-only formats limited to 1MiB per format. Unknown/rich formats, missing X-Resource, unknown native client identity, same application using a different X connection can refuse.

Private provider may persist as clipboard owner like xsel to keep restored snapshot or unresolved queued literal; next owner/SelectionClear terminates it after existing transfers finish. Cancellation is not a false restoration claim.
Windows clipboard timed implementation did not gain this X11 acknowledgement mechanism. Native Windows Unicode remains separate. No new Windows replay run.
No full suite, installed E2E, release, or p95<=100ms claim from this scoped slice. Parent owns integration checks.

A live abandoned requestor may keep an existing INCR transfer alive after SelectionClear until it finishes or its native window is destroyed; no arbitrary timeout fabricates successful transfer. Native destruction cleanup and live completion are both exercised.
64-pair MULTIPLE resource bound; unsupported/nested/side-effect targets are refused per pair.
